title: Advice to learn piano first
summary: Jackson advises any young musician to study piano as the foundation for every instrument.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: That's one of the good advantage of that young training of that violin and piano.
I advise any kid, if he's going to take music, please try to learn the piano --
-- as much as he can because that is the foundation. That's the foundation of any instrument that you want to learn.
